name: cavemio-morphing-nav
title: Morphing nav
description: One dropdown that follows you along the menu, gliding and resizing to each item’s content.

cavemio.accessibility:
- A labelled navigation landmark. Items that open a panel are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls; links stay links.
- Left and Right move between items, Enter, Space or Down opens one and moves focus into it, and Escape closes it and returns focus.
- On touch screens, items open and close with a tap; with a mouse, a short delay lets you cross the gap to the panel.
- With reduced motion the panel switches content in place without gliding.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: items
props.description: – · Items with content open the panel; items with only an href are links.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: 16 · Space kept from the screen edges when placing the panel.

features.title: One panel for every item
features.description: Point at an item and the panel drops in, sized to that item’s content. Give each panel its own width.

features.title: Content slides from where you came
features.description: Moving to the next item glides and resizes the same panel, with the new content arriving from the side you moved toward.

features.title: A highlight that follows
features.description: A soft highlight slides under the item you point at or focus.

features.title: Time to cross the gap
features.description: With a mouse, a short delay lets you reach the panel. On touch, items open and close with a tap.

features.title: It stays on screen
features.description: The panel keeps a margin from the screen edges and shifts to stay inside them.

features.title: Links stay links
features.description: Items with only an href are links. Arrow keys move along the bar, and Escape closes the panel and returns focus.

states.title: hover
states.description: A soft highlight slides and resizes under the item you point at or focus.

states.title: open
states.description: The panel drops in under the item, sized to its content and kept inside the screen.

states.title: move
states.description: The panel glides and resizes (380ms) to the next item’s content; old content slides out one way, new content in from the other.

states.title: close
states.description: Leaving the menu, Escape or a click elsewhere fades the panel away; Escape returns focus to the item.
